title: DNA extraction from insect gut-dwelling fungi
author: Yan Wang
materials: Leave the cap open on rack.

steps.title: Suspend sample in CTAB
steps.instruction: Suspend fungal thalli and spores in a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube containing 200 µL of 2× CTAB buffer.

steps.title: Perform three freeze‑thaw cycles
steps.instruction: Freeze‑thaw the tube three times by submerging it in liquid nitrogen, then incubating at 65 °C using a heat block; repeat for a total of three cycles.

steps.title: Crush fungal tissue
steps.instruction: After the final thaw, crush the fungal tissue with a disposable pellet pestle suitable for a 1.5 mL microtube.

steps.title: Cool on ice
steps.instruction: Place the tube on ice for 1 minute.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL of Proteinase K (20 mg/mL) and mix by inverting the tube three times.

steps.title: Incubate at 65 °C
steps.instruction: Warm the tube at 65 °C for 30 minutes in a heat block.

steps.title: First centrifugation and transfer
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12,000 × g, room temperature, for 2 minutes; transfer the supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Chloroform‑isoamyl extraction
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to the supernatant, shake slowly on a rotator for 10 minutes, then let the tube stand on the rack for 2 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Second centrifugation and transfer
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13,000 × g, room temperature, for 4 minutes; transfer the upper aqueous layer to another tube using wide‑bore tips, avoiding shearing DNA.

steps.title: Repeat organic extraction
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase to a fresh tube and repeat steps 8 and 9 (chloroform‑isoamyl addition, shaking, and centrifugation).

steps.title: Add RNase A and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL of RNase A (10 mg/mL) and incubate at 37 °C for 40 minutes.

steps.title: Add isopropanol and mix
steps.instruction: Add isopropanol stored at –20 °C equal to 66 % of the current volume, then mix by inversion.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA at 4 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 4 °C for at least 5 hours (or overnight) until the DNA is fully precipitated.

steps.title: Pellet DNA by high‑speed centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13,000 × g, room temperature, for 10 minutes with the cap opening side pointing toward the centrifuge centre.

steps.title: Discard supernatant and dry tube
steps.instruction: Immediately dump the supernatant, then place the tube (cap open and upside down) on a paper towel to absorb remaining liquid.

steps.title: Ethanol wash of DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL of 70 % ethanol (stored at –20 °C) to the pellet, cap the tube, and gently tap with a finger to mix.

steps.title: Centrifuge ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13,000 × g, room temperature, for 1 minute; discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Repeat high‑speed centrifugation
steps.instruction: Repeat the centrifugation at 13,000 × g, room temperature, for 10 minutes (as in step 14).

steps.title: Dry DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Leave the tube with the cap open, place a piece of Kimwipe on top, and incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes or until the DNA pellet is dry.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA in water
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of H₂O to the dried DNA, let stand for 10 minutes, then pipette to resuspend.

steps.title: Store DNA at –20 °C
steps.instruction: Store the DNA solution at –20 °C.
